subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about US payer cohorts for your mid-core and RPG slate. The competitive set has tightened: strategy and mid-core downloads grew about 14.5% in 2025, and the category now drives roughly 21.4% of mobile game revenue off only 4% of downloads. North American mid-core CPI now sits near $5.45, which makes payer quality and incrementality the line that decides real cost. We read each cohort against a holdout so paid growth adds payers on top of your organic base. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: 2025 strategy/mid-core revenue + download surge (sourced) + NA mid-core CPI band $5.45
register_notes: Stage 2 EN gaming_midcore_hardcore: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior email; fresh angle = timely 2025 strategy/mid-core growth (downloads +14.5%, ~21.4% of revenue from ~4% of downloads, segwise) plus NA mid-core CPI ~$5.45 (udonis/Liftoff); market numbers are real and web-verified with source URLs; MobUpps holdout reference carries no figure, so zero illustrative flags this stage; 1 question mark; native US register; no em dash; no X-not-Y; no sign-off.
